messages:
emily_pm: Proposal: "optic" micro-rollout for regional fallback. Goal: validate paths with tiny blast radius + AB signal. Posting short plan for review.

raj_eng: bullets pls (percent/regions/duration)

emily_pm: plan:
- cohort: 0.5% global traffic
- sequence: day0 us-east-1 -> day1 us-west-2 -> day3 eu-west-1 if stable
- AB inside cohort: 50/50 fallback vs current behavior
- duration: 24h per region baseline, extend to 72h if stable
- opt-in model: default eligible, support can add tenant to exempt CSV

mia_sre: kill-switch + automation?

emily_pm: flag: feature.fallback.optic_micro (server-side); shiproom abort button; automation = 3 consecutive 5m windows breaching gates triggers auto-failover to current behavior (not full rollback). Manual immediate rollback allowed. 15m cooldown after any automated action.

devex_jordan: SDK/console names? route overrides?

emily_pm: SDK flag name above, route override key: fallback_override, tenant flag: fallback.tenant_holdout. Console: new tile under Experiments -> Optic Micro showing cohort and AB split.

raj_eng: gates so SRE can create monitors?

emily_pm: gates:
- p50_latency_delta_ms: 120
- request_error_rate_pct: 0.4
- fallback_success_rate_pct: 99
- small eval: eval-set "optic-mini" run daily
- cost_token_delta_pct soft threshold: +10%

mia_sre: recommend 3-strike rule on p50/error then auto action; log decision reasons to rollout-audit stream. Also synthetic preflight: 10m fallback load per region.

devex_jordan: telemetry: add fallback_reason enum, route_id, trace_link; sample 0.2% full payloads to private S3 for offline eval; metric fallback_count by tenant.

raj_eng: AB metrics: token_cost_per_request, p50_latency, quality_pass_rate from eval set, plus retention signals for small subset. Keep AB results internal.

infra-bot: ci: pipelines/rollouts/optic_micro/1788888001 queued by @emily_pm. link: https://ci.internal/redwood/rollouts/1788888001

emily_pm: runbook (short):
1) emergency stop: POST https://ops.internal/flags/feature.fallback.optic_micro/deactivate
2) force route fallback: POST /admin/routes/{route}/override {"fallback":"off"}
3) collect traces: /admin/collect-traces?since=now-1h&tag=rollback
4) postmortem: create incident with tags rollout/optic_micro and assign SRE/ENG leads

mia_sre: I'll build dashboards and add auto-alerts per gates. Will also prepare exempt-tenants.csv export for ops.

emily_pm: thanks all. target open-canary Friday 12:00 UTC pending thumbs. please ack in 2h. :white_check_mark:
